ons_version.description: ONS specification version this profile conforms to.

compatibility_mode.description: Validation profile: strict fails on any finding, standard fails on errors, advisory never fails.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this conformance declaration.

description.description: Human-readable description of this conformance profile.

product_root.description: Top-level namespace root for this project (e.g. eco, atlas).

governance_record_name.description: Name used for governance records in this project (e.g. PASS).

governance_directory.description: Repository-relative path to the governance records directory.

cluster_registry.description: Repository-relative path to the cluster registry file.

token_prefix.description: CSS custom property prefix for this project's design tokens (e.g. --eco).

namespace_roots.description: Declared product namespace roots (e.g. eco.ui, eco.ai).

token_registry.description: Repository-relative path to the token registry or token list file.

implementation_reference.description: Repository-relative path to the reference validator or linter implementation.

source_passes.description: ONS governance IDs (e.g. ONS.00) that this conformance profile was derived from.

naming_examples.description: Optional map of domain names to canonical example values for this project.
